title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um corretor de imóveis para integrar a equipe da RE/MAX Capital no Distrito Federal. Esse cargo envolve atividades diárias como atendimento a clientes, realização de visitas a propriedades, intermediação de negociações imobiliárias e gestão de carteira de imóveis. O profissional atuará no formato presencial, promovendo vendas e locações de imóveis residenciais e comerciais com excelência e profissionalismo.
Qualificações
Corretagem de Imóveis e Gestão de Propriedades: Experiência como corretor de imóveis e habilidades em gestão de propriedades.
Atendimento ao Cliente: Proficiente em prestar um atendimento de qualidade e personalizado, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
Vendas e Negociação: Capacidade comprovada de realizar vendas e conduzir negociações eficazes, maximizando resultados para todas as partes envolvidas.
Mercado Imobiliário Residencial: Conhecimento em imóveis residenciais e tendência de mercado na região do Distrito Federal.
Desejável possuir registro no CRECI ativo.
Se não possuir registro no CRECI orientamos como obter o registro e iniciar o estagio conosco.

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
i Merit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.
Role Responsibilities:
Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards. Skills & Competencies:
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools. Requirements:
Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of
Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage
you to apply!

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion Required Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus About Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients' needs.

title: Analista operações logísticas, amzl
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back, podendo haver mudanças de turno.Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.Key job responsibilities- Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;- Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;- Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;- Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;- Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;- Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.- MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.- Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.- Inglês básico.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Inglês avançado.- Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes.

title: Technical business analyst id52085
description:
Agile Engine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Business Analyst in data and digital transformation, you will play a pivotal role in connecting business goals with technical solutions, shaping how teams leverage data and integrations across the organization. You’ll influence the design of processes, pipelines, and analytics, driving efficiency and insight while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, contributing directly to measurable impact and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative culture.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Partner with stakeholders across departments to capture and validate business needs;
- Translate business concepts into structured technical requirements, use cases, and user stories;
- Define data and integration requirements in collaboration with architects;
- Map current- and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency;
- Maintain a clear traceability matrix linking business requests to delivered functionality;
- Work with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to clarify metric definitions, data transformations, and aggregation rules;
- Support efforts to standardize KPIs and enable self-service analytics using BI tools;
- Validate data outputs and ensure alignment with business definitions and governance standards;
- Collaborate with data governance leadership to ensure quality, compliance, and consistent usage of data assets;
- Assist in the design and implementation of new data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations across cloud environments;
- Partner with architects to document data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and system dependencies;
- Analyze and communicate technical constraints, data availability, and system impacts to business sponsors;
- Coordinate with engineering teams to perform user acceptance testing and validate results.
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts;
- Strong ability to bridge business language and technical concepts;
- Knowledge of data systems , cloud services (AWS preferred) , and integration frameworks such as APIs ;
- Experience writing detailed functional specifications , user stories , process diagrams , and acceptance criteria ;
- Understanding of data modeling concepts , ETL pipelines , and BI/reporting workflows ;
- Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;
- Collaborative approach in team settings spanning technical and business disciplines;
- Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries;
- Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and data catalog systems.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, Tech Talks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

description:

Especialista em vendas (Saa S)
Desenho de atuação:
Converter as oportunidades qualificadas (SQLs) geradas pela equipe de pré-vendas (SDRs) em novos negócios e receita para a empresa. Desenvolver e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas e de alto impacto;
Conduzir follow-ups estratégicos para avançar a oportunidade no funil de vendas;
Mapear e contornar objeções complexas, tanto técnicas quanto comerciais;
Conduzir negociações de preço, prazos e condições contratuais com tomadores de decisão;
Utilizar técnicas avançadas de fechamento para garantir a assinatura do contrato e a aquisição do novo cliente;
Gerenciar o pipeline de oportunidades (SQLs), garantindo um forecast de vendas preciso e atualizado.• Manter todas as etapas da negociação e os próximos passos rigorosamente documentados no CRM.• Colaborar com outras áreas (jurídico, financeiro, implantação) para garantir uma transição suave do novo cliente;
Construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com os principais stakeholders e tomadores de decisão nas contas-alvo;
Atuar como um consultor, ajudando o cliente a enxergar o valor e o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) da solução. O que buscamos
Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
Inglês intermediário;
Experiência em vendas B2 B, preferencialmente em vendas complexas ou de soluções de tecnologia (Saa S);
Gestão de metas de vendas;
Habilidade em prospecção e fechamento;
Competências: resiliência, visão estratégica, e comunicação. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas negociações complexas simultaneamente, cumprimento de processos e negociação.
Domínio das metodologias de vendas consultivas (como SPIN Selling e The Challenger Sale) para diagnosticar problemas e conduzir negociações;
Conhecimento em retorno sobre o Investimento (ROI);
Conhecimento em CRM e Linked In Sales Navigator e gestão do pipeline. O que oferecemos:
Atuação Home office;
Benefícios: R$ 460,00;
Remuneração composta por fixo R$ 4.000,00 (CLT) e comissão variável por metas e resultados.

title: Consultor(a) comercial em saúde — consultas, procedimentos e cirurgias
description:
Consultor(a) Comercial em Saúde — Consultas, Procedimentos e Cirurgias (PJ | Hibrido - Zona Sul/SP)
Missão da Vaga:
Atuar de forma estratégica na conversão de leads em consultas, procedimentos e cirurgias, conduzindo o processo comercial de ponta a ponta, do primeiro contato ao fechamento.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com forte perfil comercial, focado(a) em resultados, capaz de realizar uma venda consultiva baseada em relacionamento, condução ativa, follow-ups estruturados e negociação eficiente.
Você será responsável por transformar demanda em faturamento, garantindo uma jornada fluida e segura para o paciente, desde o interesse inicial até a tomada de decisão.
Contará com o suporte do time de marketing da Atem, com fluxo contínuo de leads qualificados e materiais estratégicos, proporcionando maior previsibilidade e eficiência nas vendas.
Sobre a Atem
Somos uma assessoria de marketing digital em processo comercial especializada no setor da saúde. Nossa missão é alavancar as vendas de clínicas e médicos, oferecendo previsibilidade e constância no crescimento do faturamento. Atendemos uma variedade de especialistas, com soluções em tráfego pago, assessoria comercial e posicionamento digital estratégico.
Responsabilidades:
Comercial 1 — Abordagem & Qualificação: fazer o primeiro contato (prioridade para ligação; usar Whats App quando aplicável), diagnosticar dor, urgência, indicação e capacidade de pagamento; registrar no CRM e definir próxima ação/ prazo; Agendamento & Show Rate: agendar consulta e garantir comparecimento com confirmações, lembretes, reencaixes e lista de espera; monitorar e melhorar show rate; Comercial 2 — Proposta & Fechamento: apresentar e negociar orçamento conforme tabela de cada médico, alinhar expectativas e próximos passos; aplicar urgência/escassez de forma ética; Comercial 2 – Agendamentos e conclusão da venda: Agendar com hospitais e prestadores que participarão do procedimento; Venda de Relacionamento: construir vínculo empático, educar sobre a jornada (sem promessas clínicas) e contornar objeções; Follow-ups & Reativações: executar cadência estruturada (ligação/Whats App/e-mail) até a decisão; retomar orçamentos vencidos e no-shows; CRM & Rotinas: operar o Kommo com funis separados por médico, tarefas, motivos de perda e previsibilidade; usar Click Up/planilhas para controles específicos; Integração com Clínicas: alinhar datas cirúrgicas com cada equipe; Treinos & Alinhamentos: participar de reuniões de treinamento, análise de métricas e ajustes com Marketing focados em vendas; Relatórios & KPIs: reportar KPIs por médico (semanal) e consolidado (mensal). Requisitos:
Experiência em venda consultiva/inside sales (atuação ponta a ponta);
Disciplina de processo: domínio de follow-ups, contorno de objeções e negociação;
Infraestrutura remota: computador, internet estável headset (diferencial); Diferenciais:
Vendas de procedimentos/cirurgias (saúde/estética);
Experiência em intermediação de hospitais e médicos;
Kommo (ou similar), Click Up e planilhas para relatórios;
Vivência com leads de tráfego pago e social selling Pacote de Remuneração:
Modelo de contratação: PJ
Híbrido
Horário flexível -- aqui o que importa é atender com agilidade e eficiência
Pacote: R$2.000,00 (fixo) + Comissão por consulta agendada e comparecida + comissão por procedimento/cirurgia realizado
Oportunidade de crescimento na área dentro da Atem (função promissora)

title: Client experience specialist
description:
OverviewAdapt CFO is a fast-growing outsourced accounting and finance firm supporting small and mid-sized businesses across the U. S.
We are hiring a Client Experience Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of client delivery, billing accuracy, and operational coordination across the business.
This role sits at the center of our organization, working directly with clients, our accounting team, and leadership to ensure:
Deliverables are completed on time and within budget
Billing is accurate and aligned with work performed
Clients are supported and retained
Operational processes run efficiently as we scale Success in this role means creating a consistent, reliable client experience while reducing internal bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for growth.
This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a clear path into leadership as the company grows. Key Responsibilities Client Experience & Communication
Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
Proactively identify and resolve client issues Delivery & Budget Accountability
Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
Flag risks early and drive resolution Billing & Revenue Accuracy
Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes Upsells & Account Growth
Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow Onboarding
Support onboarding of new clients
Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows Team Coordination
Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U. S.-based CFOs
Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed Operations & Process Improvement
Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
Support operational structure as the company scales What Success Looks Like
Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
Monthly closes are consistently on time
Work is delivered within budgeted hours
Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution Qualifications
2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
Strong written and verbal English communication skills
Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities
Ability to hold team members accountable in a professional way
Experience in accounting, finance, or professional services is a strong plus
Experience with tools like Quick Books, Hub Spot, or similar platforms is a plus CompensationBase Salary: $24,000 – $42,000 USD (depending on experience) Performance Bonus
Annual bonus tied to client retention
Additional upside tied to upsell support and revenue growth Why Adapt CFO
Fully remote team
High ownership role with direct impact on the business
Clear path to leadership as the company grows
Exposure to U. S.-based clients and finance operations
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence

About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.
Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.
The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:
· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a " CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.
É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

Buscamos uma pessoa que queira evoluir 1% a cada dia  e crescer junto com a nossa empresa e que tenha espírito de dono , responsabilidade e muita proatividade. Somos empreendedores. Sonhamos alto, somos ousados, acreditamos na nossa capacidade, nos baseando na premissa de que juntos somos mais fortes  e com a colaboração chegamos mais longe. Acompanhar e analisar entradas, saídas, consumos produtivos, transferências e ajustes de estoque no sistema, garantindo correta classificação e impacto nos resultados.
Identificar e explicar variações de custo (preço médio, variações cambiais, diferenças de compra, perdas e ajustes), propondo planos de ação quando necessário.
Gerir o orçamento da área de Suprimentos, acompanhando realizado vs. orçado, analisando desvios e apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.
Implementar e acompanhar KPIs financeiros e operacionais, como custo médio, giro de estoque, cobertura, variações de compras e impacto no COGS.
Apoiar a evolução dos controles e da governança de estoque no ERP, garantindo rastreabilidade e confiabilidade das informações.
Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos que conectam operação, sistema e resultado financeiro.

Experiência sólida com apuração de custos e fechamento mensal de estoque.

Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para transitar entre operação e finanças. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência em ambiente industrial ou cadeia de suprimentos. Conhecimento em SAP (preferencialmente SAP B1).

title: Junior business analyst
description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You’ll work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. Some examples of the specific work may include interviewing clients, leading client teams, building financial models, and working with Mc Kinsey subject experts to develop perspectives and insights for the client. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site. 
When you join Mc Kinsey, you are joining a firm that will invest in your professional development. You will participate in an introductory training program, as well as a range of social activities to get to know your office and the firm. 
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will receive training and coaching on how to better:

Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values Mc Kinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include: 

Engagement colleagues and leadership who will provide feedback regularly to help you improve your daily performance
A professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams
A senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals At the end of your Junior Business Analyst program, you may receive an offer to become a Business Analyst.
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office to work in teams and directly with our clients. This 6 to 24-month program was created to develop talents into real leaders through research, training, mentoring, and coaching sessions. 
Your team colleagues will make you feel welcome and help you be at your best during client engagements. The Professional Development team will complement your experience by tailoring a learning and training program for you, considering your strengths and development needs. 
In this role you will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world – across the private, public, and social sectors – solve some of their most difficult problems, while you discover coaches, mentors, sponsors and friends in your learning program.

Undergraduate degree in any course, except business administration, economics and engineering
Graduation between Dec 2022 and Jul 2026
Ability to communicate ideas most effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and Portuguese
Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
Capability to drive an independent workstream in the context of a broader team project
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations

description:
At Baires Dev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.
Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.
When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.
Growth Product Manager at Baires Dev
We are looking for a Growth Product Manager to join our Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Director of Growth Product. We are looking for someone who has experience as a growth product manager or as a product manager with a focus on commercial or adoption metrics (eg user acquisition). This person will be responsible for leading a core team of growth marketers, engineers, designers, and copywriters, all working together on a day-to-day basis to identify potential avenues for growth and executing on them. This may take the form of improving the end-to-end user experience, creating landing pages, designing and/or redesigning user journeys, optimizing site navigation, SEO optimization, among other initiatives.
What You Will Do:
- Contribute significantly to strategy, managing internal stakeholders, and helping to nurture a strong product management culture in the organization. - Execute on the roadmap - own the lifecycle from ideation and conception to evaluation and conclusion, performing, driving, or facilitating all necessary activities such as business analysis, engineering tasks, quantitative and/or qualitative research, experiment design, etc. - Contribute to the creation of the growth product roadmap by identifying and suggesting initiatives from quantitative and qualitative research. - Ensure high effectiveness and alignment within the growth product teams through communication, and continual examination of our processes and rituals, suggesting and designing improvements. - Help to create and nurture a positive and fun culture with a fully distributed team.
Here’s what we are looking for:
- Experience working in an agile product or growth product squad as a product manager or growth product manager on a customer-facing product (or website). - Strong quantitative skills, including knowledge of web analytics tools. - Foundational knowledge of growth marketing channels, such as SEO and Google Ads. - Exceptional attention to detail and high thresholds for quality. - Deeply curious, highly empathetic, and organized. - Excellent interpersonal skills - written and verbal - and a natural collaborator and unifier. - Experience in B2 B businesses. - The ability to wireframe or sketch ideas using design and whiteboard tools. - Advanced English level.
Desirable:
- Familiarity with CMS platforms, particularly Word Press. - Experience with SQL and/or Tableau. - Experience working with distributed teams. - Worked on lead generation.
How we make your work (and your life) easier:
100% remote work (from anywhere).
Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Human resources assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions
Do you live in BRAZIL and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
Can you type both fast and accurately?
Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income?
Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?
Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!
About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.
Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:
Compensation:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.
The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:
· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a " CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.
Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office
Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.
Minimum Education/Experience Requirements
Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement).
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred. GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!
About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

title: Operations analyst
description:
Operations Analyst – Sneaker Startup (Remote)
We're a sneaker startup founded in 2021, operating across Brazil and the European Union. We move fast, we care about the details, and we believe great operations are what separate a good customer experience from an unforgettable one.
We're looking for an Operations Analyst to be the backbone of our day-to-day — someone who thrives in a lean environment, takes ownership naturally, and is always looking for smarter ways to get things done.
⸻
What You'll Own
• End-to-end order fulfillment across B2 C (Shopify) and B2 B channels, ensuring customers receive their orders smoothly, on time, and at the best cost-efficiency possible
• Inventory management: monitoring stock levels and coordinating replenishment orders to avoid shortages or overstock
• Logistics optimization: evaluating carriers, routes, and processes to continuously improve cost and delivery performance
• Financial control: maintaining spreadsheets, organizing invoices (payables and receivables), and preparing documentation for our accounting team
• Operational tooling: identifying and implementing technology and AI-powered solutions to make our operations smarter and more scalable
⸻
You Might Be a Great Fit If You
• Have experience in operations, logistics, or supply chain, ideally in e-commerce or a startup environment
• Are comfortable working with Shopify and spreadsheet-based financial controls
• Have a process-improvement mindset, you don't just execute, you question and optimize
• Are familiar with (or excited to explore) AI tools and automation platforms like Make, Zapier, or similar
• Can navigate a global operation with a lean team, you're resourceful and don't wait to be told what to do
• Are fluent in English and Portuguese
⸻
About Us
We're a young, ambitious sneaker brand with roots in Brazil and Europe, building something global from the ground up. If you want to be part of a team where your work directly shapes how the company grows, this is it.

Participar de reuniões e rotinas diárias da empresa. Requisitos:

Boa capacidade de organização e gerenciamento de tempo;

title: Senior asterisk specialist / latam
description:
DescriptionWe are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced Vo IP implementations
English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:
A1 Beginner
A2 Elementary
B1 Intermediate
B2 Upper-Intermediate
C1 Advanced
C2 Proficient Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality, channel drivers, and application problems.
Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
Assist with custom Asterisk builds, patches, and telephony application development.
Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
Optimize Asterisk performance, memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations. Requirements
8+ years of experience in engineering, including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
Deep expertise in Asterisk internals, including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
Advanced Vo IP knowledge, covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
Experience with custom development, specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

title: Ai program manager
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Program Manager to join our innovative and dynamic team.
Employment Type: Full Time
Location: Brazil, Bulgaria, or Romania. Candidates who are able to work hybrid from our Sofia, Bulgaria or São Carlos, Brazil offices will be given preference.
Industry: IT & Services
AI Program Manager | About You
As an AI Program Manager, you are responsible for coordinating and driving execution across AI‐focused software delivery teams. You bring strong experience supporting programs that involve machine learning workflows, data governance, model development, and cloud‐based AI product delivery. You thrive in Agile environments and excel at bringing structure, alignment, and predictability to complex cross‐team initiatives. You communicate clearly with engineering, product, and data science partners, ensuring dependencies, risks, and priorities are well understood. You are detail‐oriented, highly organized, and skilled at maintaining governance standards while enabling teams to deliver AI capabilities efficiently and consistently.
AI Program Manager | Day-to-Day
Facilitate Agile ceremonies for AI and ML engineering PODs, ensuring all teams follow established AI delivery frameworks and governance processes.
Coordinate planning activities with Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Architecture by documenting requirements, dependencies, milestones, and risks.
Maintain governance artifacts including schedules, RAID logs, decision records, and AI‐specific delivery documentation.
Track progress across AI workstreams, capturing updates from sprint reviews, model checkpoints, training cycles, and evaluation sessions.
Support cross‐functional alignment by coordinating client engagement logistics, AI use‐case prioritization, and model delivery readiness.
Prepare bi‐weekly delivery reports summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and upcoming AI release milestones using Smartsheet, Azure Dev Ops, or similar tools. AI Program Manager | Skills & Experience
5+ years of experience supporting software, Saa S, or AI/ML delivery programs in an Agile environment.
Proven experience coordinating AI‐enabled product development, including data pipelines, model training workflows, feature engineering, or ML deployment cycles.
Strong ability to manage inter‐team dependencies and align work across Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, and Cloud Engineering teams.
Experience maintaining program schedules, RAID logs, delivery documentation, and governance artifacts across multiple PODs or workstreams.
Proficiency with tools such as Smartsheet, Azure Dev Ops, and Confluence, including structured reporting and dashboard creation.
Familiarity with AI delivery concepts including data governance, model lifecycle stages, technical risks, and responsible AI considerations.

AI Program Manager | About You
As an AI Program Manager, you are responsible for coordinating and driving execution across AI‐focused software delivery teams. You bring strong experience supporting programs that involve machine learning workflows, data governance, model development, and cloud‐based AI product delivery. You thrive in Agile environments and excel at bringing structure, alignment, and predictability to complex cross‐team initiatives. 5+ years of experience supporting software, Saa S, or AI/ML delivery programs in an Agile environment.
Proven experience coordinating AI‐enabled product development, including data pipelines, model training workflows, feature engineering, or ML deployment cycles.
Strong ability to manage inter‐team dependencies and align work across Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, and Cloud Engineering teams.
Experience maintaining program schedules, RAID logs, delivery documentation, and governance artifacts across multiple PODs or workstreams.
Proficiency with tools such as Smartsheet, Azure Dev Ops, and Confluence, including structured reporting and dashboard creation.
Familiarity with AI delivery concepts including data governance, model lifecycle stages, technical risks, and responsible AI considerations.

title: Fp&a director
description:
We are seeking an FP& A Director for a large multinational technology company, one of the leading global players in its segment, to lead a globally operating FP& A Hub.
The FP& A Director will be responsible for leading and structuring a high-impact team focused on providing strategic insights and financial guidance to senior stakeholders across the organization. This role is accountable for the end-to-end financial planning cycle, including forecasting, budgeting, performance tracking and financial analysis, ensuring robust support for business decision-making and operational efficiency.
Acting as a key business partner, this professional will work closely with Finance Directors, Vice Presidents and Corporate leadership, playing a pivotal role in strengthening financial governance, supporting executive decisions and driving the consolidation of financial performance across all business units.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Take full ownership of the P& L, covering both actual results and forward-looking projections, for internal and external purposes;
Lead the Mid-Term planning cycle, actively contributing to long-term strategic decision-making;
Coordinate monthly and quarterly closing processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of financial information;
Consolidate results across all Americas operations, providing visibility into variances and underlying business drivers beyond purely technical consolidation;
Deliver structured and insightful analysis to senior stakeholders, including the CFO and executive committees, supporting key business decisions;
Drive target-setting processes and ensure adherence to financial guidelines across the region.
Lead, engage, and develop a large team, setting clear direction, expectations, and promoting a high-performance culture;
Act as a transformation agent, promoting efficiency improvements, leveraging new tools and systems, and challenging existing processes;
Maintain strong interaction with senior management, providing regular updates and guidance on financial plans;
Ensure clear direction for the team, including goal-setting, performance expectations, and ongoing professional development support;
Manage and develop a team of financial analysts. QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Accounting, or a related field;
Fluency in English is mandatory;
Professional accounting certification is considered a plus;
Solid experience in FP& A and/or financial analysis roles;
Proven track record in leading large teams, including leadership of team leads;
Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling;
Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, including CFO-level;
Previous experience in multinational companies or dynamic, fast-paced environments;
Experience in a Big Four firm is considered a strong plus;
Advanced proficiency in SAP and Excel; familiarity with automation and BI tools is a plus.

title: Clinical application specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with Fibro Scan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.
Fibro Scan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.
Echosens has made Fibro Scan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.
Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.
In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.
Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.
To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:
CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)
LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)
The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.
This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.
Main activities:
Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise Experience / Education / Special Requirements
You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.
You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.
Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.
You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.
Please submit your application and CV in English.
Why join ECHOSENS ?
Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.

title: Clinical application specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with Fibro Scan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.
Fibro Scan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.
Echosens has made Fibro Scan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.
Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.
In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.
Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.
To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:
CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)
LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)
The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.
This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.
Main activities:
Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise Experience / Education / Special Requirements
You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.
You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.
Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.
You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.
Please submit your application and CV in English.
Why join ECHOSENS ?
Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities. ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.
